status: CPU proposal only; generated prototype is diagnostic, not shipped data
requiredRetention: All old positive original source road nodes and exact XY; synthetic clipped ends may retire only with an explicit literal-ramp replacement record.
Every old core and scenery source-way identity, raw tags, source node order, literal widths/access, exact existing building footprints/holes/dimensions/roof profiles and canopy models.
All prior measured source crowns/centres/radii/info and every mapped tree; broad 2D road overlap is not physical exclusion evidence.
All prior mapped area/water/line/parking/POI/furniture/source records. Additional true source context is listed separately.
Cache signatures and source ownership geometry regenerated only after retention gates; changed caches and metadata are explicit, not silently considered pixel parity.

profileProtocol.before: Actual9fc captured1103core edges, after canopy correction;5515endpoint/quarter queries prepared. Actual endpoint values and reconstructed linear-interior values labelled separately.
profileProtocol.after: Fresh native world.roadHeight(x,z,explicit source edge), preserving every matching same-source result. No nearest-road/level fallback, zero fill or best-fit height selection.
profileProtocol.coverage: All retained old core roads, including every Pasaj source station and all ordinary streets, not just a radius sample. Fresh paired exports must additionally capture passive scenery/grade provenance.
profileProtocol.deltaPolicy: Retain every nonzero height delta. Record interior/source-join changes explicitly and review any unrelated change. No generic depth correction hidden in the domain.

mandatoryMOLStep: After any full rebuild, reapply/revalidate game/research/covered-road-models-bucharest-unirii.json using append-covered-road-models.mjs and exact retained source XML. Otherwise the known false Coposu tunnel seed returns.
metadataScope: Unexpanded current compiler keeps all raw rail runs and original source-way records, but enriches route context and changes missingWayIds availability; line/area/node metadata and cached surface geometry also change. These effects require explicit review/native gates, not an unrelated silent update.
nativeRequired: Before/after complete first-publication body/source admission; full native population/IDs and flags recorded.
Real public source approach/descent/covered passage/exit/return, sides/mirror, no hidden player placement or invented joins.
Safe ordinary signal waiting through complete cycles; retain observer reset requests without executingR.
Independent actual mesh/roof/ground/water/body checks and current submitted main/mirror/shadow budgets.
